## Need
The main text is over the NeurIPS 2026 limit (9 content pages including figures and tables; more is a desk rejection; references, appendix and checklist are outside, `venue.md` §Page limit).

## Evidence
`document` branch, `dev/document.pdf` built from `3bc530abcd99` (and `main/document.pdf` built from `1a8b7399ce88`, the same): "6 Discussion and limitations" starts on p. 9 and runs onto **p. 10 (9 lines: the end of "Limitations", ll. 339–347)**; "References" starts on p. 10, line 348. The previous build (`34568977ca28`) fitted: main text ended on p. 9. The overrun came with the later text and the new tables (Tables 5/8 in the main body).

## For
Cut or move to the appendix at least ~10 lines (more for slack, since a later edit can push it over again) so that the last main-text line is on p. 9 — without changing margins, font size or spacing (the style kit forbids it). Whoever reviews `release` should check the page of the last main-text line, not the total count.

## Waits
Nothing else from the venue side: template unchanged since `3daa538`, anonymity, fonts, checklist as checked on `eabd347e5737`.

shown.message:
The main text now runs 9 lines onto page 10, which breaks NeurIPS's 9-page limit (exceeding it is a desk rejection). The last build that fitted was `34568977ca28`. The build on `dev` (`3bc530abcd99`) and `main` (`1a8b7399ce88`) has the end of "Limitations" on page 10, ahead of the References heading. The paper grew with later text and new tables, so I flagged it.

- **Issue:** I opened `paper-repo`#9 asking the report owner to cut or move to the appendix at least about 10 lines, with some slack. Margins, font size and spacing can't be changed, because the style kit forbids it.
- **Pull request:** I also commented on `paper-repo`#7 (`main` into `release`) so the reviewers see that this version misses a venue requirement.
- **Rest of the paper:** nothing else is wrong from the venue side. I last checked the template, anonymity, fonts and checklist on the earlier head `eabd347e5737`. The template is unchanged since `3daa538`.

I made no changes in my own repository this turn.
